description:
About the Scholarship

MIPDaL trains practitioners in international public diplomacy and law with a multi-round admission calendar: the scholarship and early-bird round has historically closed on 15 January, followed by windows in March and June. The 2027 cycle is expected to keep the same structure.

OpportunityMIPDaL – Master in International Public Diplomacy and Law
HostMIPDaL Consortium
LocationMadrid (multi-country mobility), Spain
Study LevelMaster's
FundingPartially Funded
StipendScholarship and early-bird fee reductions in the January
Application Deadline15 January 2027
ApplyOfficial application page ↗

MIPDaL trains practitioners in international public diplomacy and law with a multi-round admission calendar: the scholarship and early-bird round has historically closed on 15 January, followed by windows in March and June. The 2027 cycle is expected to keep the same structure.

Programme Highlights

  • Three-round admissions: January (scholarship/early-bird), March and June
  • Diplomacy-plus-law curriculum with practitioner teaching
  • Madrid-anchored programme with international placements
  • Graduates enter foreign services, international organisations and public affairs

Who Should Apply

Law, international relations, politics and communication graduates aiming at diplomatic or multilateral careers; language skills strengthen files.

Funding and Costs

Scholarship and early-bird fee reductions in the January round; later rounds at standard fees per the admission page. Confirm the exact funding package on the official page before applying.

Deadline and How to Apply

Apply through the MIPDaL admission page and target the 15 January round for scholarship and early-bird consideration. Key deadline information: 15 January 2027 (scholarship & early-bird round, expected); further rounds on 15 March 2027 and 15 June 2027.

Official Link

  • Official application page (verified link)

About MIPDaL Consortium

The MIPDaL consortium delivers the Master in International Public Diplomacy and Law, combining European university teaching with diplomatic practitioners and international-organisation partners.

Official website: https://mipdal.eu

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: 15 January 2027 - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.
